faqs.q: Do I need a savings account with SBI to get an SBI Unnati Credit Card?
faqs.a: No, you don’t need a savings account with SBI to avail this card. SBI Unnati is issued against fixed deposit of Rs. 25,000 or more. Hence, even if you don’t have a savings account with SBI, you can open an FD with SBI and apply for this card.

faqs.q: Is it possible to increase my credit limit on SBI Unnati Credit Card?
faqs.a: Yes, you can increase your credit limit by increasing your fixed deposit amount. Visit your nearest SBI branch, top up or create a new FD at a higher amount and request for credit enhancement against the revised FD.

faqs.q: What all documents do I need to apply for SBI Unnati Credit Card?
faqs.a: You need ID proof such as PAN, Aadhaar, or Passport and address proof. Additionally, you will need a fixed deposit receipt or certificate of Rs. 25,000 or more with SBI. You do not require any income proof since this card is backed by a fixed deposit.

faqs.q: Do I need a credit score to apply for SBI Unnati Credit Card?
faqs.a: No, you do not need credit score to apply for the SBI Unnati Credit Card as it is specifically designed for individuals with no credit history or a low credit score. The FD acts as a security, which eliminates the need for a credit check making it an ideal credit-building tool for those who are new to credit.

faqs.q: If I close my fixed deposit account, will my SBI Unnati Credit Card also stop functioning?
faqs.a: Since this is a secured card that is offered against a fixed deposit. Hence, if you close your FD, you will no longer be able to use your SBI Unnati Credit Card.
